work_item: Enforce the approved Human Authority gate for Canon MCP production deployment.
authority_basis: The approved automation policy explicitly places production deployment behind Human Authority, and Human Authority instructed execution to proceed.

triggering_evidence.observed_behavior: A push to main automatically triggered deploy-canon-mcp because the workflow contained a push trigger covering enforcement and preflight paths.

remediation.change: Remove the push trigger from deploy-canon-mcp and retain workflow_dispatch as the only production deployment trigger.
remediation.scope: Smallest change required to align runtime behavior with the approved Human Authority gate.
